Introducing Saved Views, available today on all paid plans. If you find yourself rebuilding the same filters and sort orders every time you open a project, this one's for you. Saved Views let you capture a fully configured list—filters, grouping, sorting, and columns—and return to it in a single click, no reconfiguring required.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can keep separate setups for sprint planning, bug triage, client reporting, or whatever your workflow demands. Views aren't just personal, either: share any saved view with your team so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating it individually. That means less time explaining "just filter by assignee and due date" and more time actually getting through the list.

Saved Views works everywhere lists already appear, so there's nothing new to install or configure beyond your first saved setup. Whether you manage one small team or coordinate across dozens of projects, this feature is designed to save clicks and keep everyone aligned on the same view of the work.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
